items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: the other guys were playing Sousa's marches and those types of things

ctx.x: But the same thing that I wrote for them to use the drum beat in that picture, that's what we used in that band, and we all walked this year, and it was nothing but a ba da dap da da da da ah da, you know, that type of thing.

And, so when we would start -- and you have to know when to start playing your music, see? You march and march because you're trying to blow the other bands out, and we did have good arrangements. We were playing things like "Christopher Columbus" and the other guys were playing Sousa's marches and those types of things, you know ... but we came in, you know, swinging!
